criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies CPOM violation from P.A.-to-corporation conversion
criteria_results.reasoning: A-1 identifies that the P.A. conversion to a business corporation owned by a PE fund violates Texas CPOM.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Recommends MSO/friendly-PC structure to address CPOM
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends a friendly P.A./MSO structure with physician ownership of the P.A.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies Adjusted EBITDA discrepancy ($29.97M vs. $29.57M)
criteria_results.reasoning: B-1 identifies $29.97M vs. QoE $29.57M ($3.97M of adjustments on $25.6M), a $0.40M overstatement.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Notes valuation impact of EBITDA overstatement
criteria_results.reasoning: Says the overstatement equals about $3.0M of enterprise value at 7.5x.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies HSR Act filing is likely required
criteria_results.reasoning: A-3 says the deal exceeds the HSR size-of-transaction threshold ($119.5M/$126.4M), so a filing appears required.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Notes penalties or consequences of failing to file HSR
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes civil penalties over $50,000 per day and potential unwinding.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies earnout lacks seller protections / efforts covenant
criteria_results.reasoning: Flags the sole-discretion operational language in §3.5(e) and notes that Texas implies no duty of good faith, so nothing protects the earnout; expects Seller to negotiate it.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies earnout dispute resolution is not independent
criteria_results.reasoning: Says the dispute resolver, 'Parent's Auditor', is not independent and should be replaced with an independent accounting firm.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies known overbilling exposure lacks specific indemnity
criteria_results.reasoning: C-1 says the $1.8M upcoding (99214 vs 99213) falls under the general reps, with Buyer absorbing the first $1.5M deductible, and has no specific indemnity.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Recommends dollar-one / specific indemnity for overbilling
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends a dollar-one specific indemnity outside the basket and cap, plus a refund or OIG self-disclosure before closing.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies Dr. Vasquez compensation exceeds FMV benchmarks
criteria_results.reasoning: States $1.2M base pay exceeds the roughly $1.05M 90th percentile benchmark.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Connects Vasquez compensation to Stark Law / AKS risk
criteria_results.reasoning: Connects the compensation to the Stark employment exception and AKS FMV requirements for a referral source.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies related-party leases are above FMV
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the three Vasquez Medical Properties leases at $1.315M, about 22% above FMV per Ridgeline/Thornfield.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Notes Stark/AKS implications of above-FMV related-party leases
criteria_results.reasoning: Ties the above-FMV rent to the Stark rental exception, the AKS safe harbor and tainted DHS referrals.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Recommends renegotiation or termination of related-party leases
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends amending the leases to FMV as a closing condition, or buying the real estate, or terminating.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies ancillary services / PT location Stark Law issue
criteria_results.reasoning: C-3 says the off-site PT facility two miles away fails the IOAS same-building test and is unlikely to qualify as a centralized building.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies undisclosed Hagerty Oklahoma Medical Board warning
criteria_results.reasoning: C-7 identifies the undisclosed 2022 Oklahoma Medical Board warning to Dr. Hagerty while Schedule 4.11(b) says None.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Notes breach of seller representation or need for disclosure
criteria_results.reasoning: Connects the warning to the inaccurate §4.11(b) representation and requires a corrected schedule.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies continuity of interest failure for tax-free reorg
criteria_results.reasoning: A-2 says 20% equity continuity falls short of the roughly 40% minimum for continuity of interest.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Notes absence of tax opinion as closing condition
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes that §6.7(e) expressly removes any tax opinion condition.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Identifies MAE definition missing healthcare-specific carveouts
criteria_results.reasoning: The MAE discussion covers the disproportionate-effect qualifier and healthcare triggers, but it does not say the definition lacks reimbursement-rate or pandemic carve-outs.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies Oklahoma physician non-compete enforceability issue
criteria_results.reasoning: C-9 says the enforceability representation is inaccurate for Oklahoma under 15 O.S. §219A.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013a: Identifies HIPAA breach / OCR investigation not addressed in closing conditions
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes the open OCR review of the 3,200-patient breach and lists OCR status among the closing conditions the draft lacks.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_013b: Identifies no specific indemnity for HIPAA fines and remediation costs
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends a dollar-one specific indemnity for OCR penalties and remediation, which the draft does not have.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Identifies expiring Plano and Frisco leases as risk
criteria_results.reasoning: E-1 flags the Plano and Frisco expirations 8-9 months after closing, with no renewal options and an effect on the earnout.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_014: Recommends lease renewal/extension as closing condition
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends Plano and Frisco extensions or replacement leases as a closing condition.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_015: Identifies missing Straddle Period tax allocation
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes that Straddle Period is defined but unused and recommends adding a customary straddle-period allocation.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_016a: Identifies J-1 visa physician HPSA service obligation risks from merger
criteria_results.reasoning: C-8 identifies four J-1 waiver physicians whose waivers the structural changes could jeopardize, triggering the home-residency requirement.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_016b: Identifies draft agreement does not address immigration compliance or HPSA continuity
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes the draft has no immigration representations or covenants and does not address HPSA site continuity.

criteria_results.title: CPOM issue rated as critical or high risk
criteria_results.reasoning: CPOM is rated Critical.

criteria_results.title: HSR filing issue rated as critical or high risk
criteria_results.reasoning: HSR is rated Critical.

criteria_results.title: Cross-references merger agreement against QofE report
criteria_results.reasoning: Explicitly cross-references the draft against the Thornfield QoE on Adjusted EBITDA and other items.

criteria_results.title: Cross-references merger agreement against regulatory compliance memo
criteria_results.reasoning: Cross-references the regulatory memo on Hagerty, upcoding and HIPAA.

criteria_results.title: Cross-references merger agreement against lease summary schedule
criteria_results.reasoning: Cites the Lease Schedule for the Plano/Frisco expirations and the related-party FMV.

criteria_results.title: Identifies that no voluntary self-disclosure has been made for overbilling
criteria_results.reasoning: States that no refund or self-disclosure has occurred and recommends one before closing.

criteria_results.title: Identifies St. Ambrose co-management agreement AKS concern
criteria_results.reasoning: C-5 flags the volume-based incentive metrics in the St. Ambrose agreement as outside the AKS safe harbor.

criteria_results.title: Notes Medicare CHOW filing requirements for the merger
criteria_results.reasoning: A-5 discusses the Medicare/Medicaid CHOW filing condition and recommends change-of-information and RHC CHOW filings.

criteria_results.title: Notes change-of-control consent requirements for third-party leases
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes all 11 third-party leases need landlord consent and recommends making the consents a closing condition.

criteria_results.title: Identifies earnout metric is revenue-based (not EBITDA)
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes the earnout is based on Consolidated Revenue and discusses the Stark/AKS implications; recommends an EBITDA metric.

criteria_results.title: Memo provides recommendations for at least 10 identified issues
criteria_results.reasoning: Gives recommendations for more than 30 issues.

criteria_results.title: Correctly identifies total government payer revenue percentage (~51%)
criteria_results.reasoning: The memo never states the roughly 51% government payer revenue share or its components.

criteria_results.title: Identifies Dr. Vasquez personal guarantees on equipment leases
criteria_results.reasoning: Mentions the $4.7M equipment leases and the Vasquez personal guarantees, and recommends their release or replacement at closing.
